metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows 5 easy ways to relieve an earache in as little as 30 seconds.

These exercises will focus on relieve pressure within the ear, promoting drainage (through the eustachian tube), and reducing tension that may be causing ear pain.

Each exercise works differently. To get the best results, go through them all and use what gives you the most pain relief.

Watch now and instantly relieve an earache!
